About this template

A medical history form is a questionnaire used by healthcare providers to collect information about the patient’s medical history during a medical or physical examination. Whether you’re a doctor, nurse, physical therapist, or other medical professional, easily collect your patient’s medical history using this free medical history form. All you need to do is customize the form to match how you want to ask your questions, and then add it to your website. Or share it with a link or embed it! That way, patients can fill out the form at home, or you can print it out and gather responses in person using a tablet or computer.

When you download our free mobile app, Jotform mobile forms, you’ll be able to view submissions on any device, even when you’re not in the office. And, you can automatically collect all the information you need by integrating the form with your other accounts. Just sync it with your crm or your storage service like Google Drive or Dropbox. Connect with your patients and capture their medical history with a free online medical history form.

About Customer Registration Forms

Customer registration forms are essential tools for businesses and organizations that need to collect and manage customer information efficiently. These forms are typically used to onboard new customers, gather contact details, verify identities, and set up user accounts for services or memberships. Whether you’re running an e-commerce store, a fitness center, a subscription service, or a loyalty program, customer registration forms help streamline the sign-up process and ensure you have accurate data for communication, marketing, and support. Use cases range from online account creation and event registrations to service subscriptions and customer loyalty programs.

With Jotform, creating and managing customer registration forms becomes a seamless experience. Jotform’s intuitive drag-and-drop Form Builder allows users to design fully customized forms without any coding knowledge. You can add various fields, integrate payment gateways, and set up conditional logic to personalize the registration process for each customer. Submissions are automatically stored in Jotform Tables, making it easy to organize, search, and manage customer data securely. By leveraging Jotform’s extensive template library and powerful customization options, businesses can quickly deploy professional registration forms that enhance user experience and support business growth.

Use Cases of Customer Registration Forms

Customer registration forms can be tailored to fit a wide variety of business needs and scenarios. Here’s how they can be used, who benefits from them, and how their content may differ depending on the use case:

1. Possible Use Cases:
Online account creation for e-commerce websites or SaaS platforms
Membership sign-ups for gyms, clubs, or associations
Event registrations for webinars, workshops, or conferences
Loyalty program enrollments for retail or hospitality businesses
Service subscriptions for newsletters, classes, or digital products
2. Problem Solving Points:
Streamlines the onboarding process for new customers
Reduces manual data entry and errors
Ensures accurate and up-to-date customer information
Facilitates targeted communication and marketing
Enhances customer experience with quick and easy sign-up
3. Possible Owners and Users:
Business owners and managers
Marketing and sales teams
Customer support representatives
Event organizers
Membership coordinators
4. Differences of Creation Methods:
E-commerce registration: May require fields for shipping address, payment details, and account preferences.
Event registration: Often includes event-specific questions, session selections, and dietary preferences.
Membership sign-up: Might ask for membership type, referral information, and agreement to terms.
Loyalty program enrollment: Typically requests contact details and consent for marketing communications.
Service subscriptions: May include subscription tier selection and recurring payment setup.

In summary, customer registration forms are versatile tools that can be adapted to various industries and purposes, with content and structure tailored to the specific needs of each use case.

How to Create a Customer Registration Form

Creating a customer registration form with Jotform is a straightforward process that can be customized to fit any business scenario, from online account creation to event sign-ups. Here’s a step-by-step guide to help you design an effective registration form that captures all the necessary information and provides a smooth experience for your customers.

1. Choose Your Starting Point
Log in to your Jotform account and click “Create” on your My Workspace page.
Select “Form” and decide whether to start from scratch or use one of Jotform’s 10,000+ templates. For common use cases like event registration or membership sign-up, templates can save time and provide inspiration.
2. Select the Appropriate Layout
Choose between Classic Form (all questions on one page) or Card Form (one question per page). For longer or more detailed registrations, Card Form can make the process feel less overwhelming.
3. Add Essential Form Elements
Use the drag-and-drop Form Builder to add fields such as:
Name, email, and phone number
Address (for shipping or contact purposes)
Password or account credentials (for online accounts)
Membership or subscription options
Event-specific questions (e.g., session selection, dietary needs)
Payment fields (integrate with gateways like PayPal or Stripe if needed)
Consent checkboxes for terms and privacy policies
4. Customize the Design
Click the Paint Roller icon to open the Form Designer.
Adjust colors, fonts, and layout to match your brand.
Add your organization’s logo and personalize the form’s appearance for a professional look.
5. Set Up Conditional Logic
Use conditional logic to show or hide fields based on user responses. For example, display additional questions for premium membership tiers or specific event sessions.
6. Configure Email Notifications
Set up autoresponder emails to confirm registration with customers.
Enable notification emails for your team to stay updated on new sign-ups.
7. Publish and Share Your Form
Click “Publish” to get a shareable link or embed the form on your website.
Share via email, social media, or QR code to reach your audience wherever they are.
8. Test and Manage Submissions
Preview your form and submit a test entry to ensure everything works as expected.
Monitor and manage registrations in Jotform Tables, where you can filter, search, and export data as needed.

By following these steps, you can create a customer registration form that not only collects the right information but also enhances the onboarding experience for your customers. Jotform’s flexible features and integrations make it easy to adapt your form to any use case, ensuring you’re always ready to welcome new customers efficiently.

Frequently Asked Questions
1. What is a customer registration form?

A customer registration form is an online or paper form used by businesses to collect essential information from new customers, such as contact details, preferences, and account credentials, to facilitate onboarding and future communication.

2. Why are customer registration forms important for businesses?

They streamline the onboarding process, ensure accurate data collection, and help businesses build a reliable customer database for marketing, support, and service delivery.

3. What information is typically collected in a customer registration form?

Common fields include name, email address, phone number, physical address, password or account details, and consent to terms and privacy policies. Additional fields may be added based on the specific use case.

4. Are there different types of customer registration forms?

Yes, forms can vary based on the purpose—such as event registration, membership sign-up, loyalty program enrollment, or online account creation—each with unique fields and requirements.

5. Who should use customer registration forms?

Any business or organization that needs to onboard new customers, members, or participants—such as retailers, service providers, event organizers, and clubs—can benefit from using these forms.

6. How do customer registration forms help with data privacy and compliance?

Well-designed forms include consent checkboxes and privacy policy links, ensuring customers are informed about how their data will be used and helping businesses comply with regulations like GDPR.

7. Can customer registration forms be integrated with other business tools?

Yes, many online form builders, including Jotform, offer integrations with CRM systems, email marketing platforms, and payment gateways to automate workflows and data management.

8. What are the best practices for designing an effective customer registration form?

Keep the form concise, only request necessary information, use clear labels, group related fields, and ensure the form is mobile-friendly to maximize completion rates and user satisfaction.

questions.text: Do you have a personal history of any of the following conditions?

Are you currently taking any prescription or over-the-counter medications? (If yes, please list them)
Do you have any known allergies to medications, food, or environmental factors?
Family Medical History (Check any that apply to your immediate family)
